item.title: Fish Audio Releases Drama 3, a 35B Open-Weight MoE Text-to-Speech Model
item.description:
Fish Audio released Drama 3, a 35B mixture-of-experts text-to-speech model with about 3B active parameters. It takes plain-language direction, covers 83 languages and ships open weights under a revenue-capped community license.

item.title: Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-24B-A2B: A 2B-Active MoE for On-Device Agents
item.description:

item.description:
